title: docs(i18n): name the measurement-widening race in check-i18n-coverage's header
body:
Fixes #14729

## What changed

`scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs` only, two additions, adopted as filed by
triage (comment 5518536856) — no baseline split, no dropped DOWN direction,
no computed number.

### 1. One sentence on the DOWN-direction remedy (was `:1340-1341`)

Before:

```
${file}: untranslated declared strings improved ${allowed} → ${now} — ratchet DOWN: run `node scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs --update` and commit the baseline.
```

After:

```
${file}: untranslated declared strings improved ${allowed} → ${now} — ratchet DOWN: run `node scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs --update` and commit the baseline. If you did not touch this population, merge `origin/main` first — the movement is probably not yours.
```

### 2. One header paragraph naming the class generally

Appended at the end of the file's header (which already opens with the #3370
narrative), stating the property in general form — not i18n-specific — plus
the campaign observation (the two collisions were not independent draws) and
the forward-looking exposure as of `224f8ea`: `app-showcase` 0 untranslated
rule messages remaining (that leg is finished); `app-crm` 5, `app-todo` 4;
`bulkActions` 18 and `datasets` 62 nobody is currently working — any of those
starting to move will race this gate the same way.

## Diff

```
$ git diff --stat origin/main
 scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs | 27 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++-
 1 file changed, 26 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
```

One file, comment/string additions only — no logic change, no baseline
movement.

## Tests

- `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` (self-test + real run) at `674bb4afe8`:
  `check-i18n-coverage: OK (13 config(s), 691 baselined untranslated string(s), none new).`
  — same 691 total as the issue's forward-exposure snapshot; no movement from
  this comment/string-only edit.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs`
  derived 18 runnable gates for this file surface; all 18 ran, 17 green,
  1 NOT MEASURED (`check-test-completeness.mjs` — its own text: "PREREQUISITE
  NOT MET… no local log… not a red, nothing here to fix").
- No self-test in this file pins the exact remedy string (grepped), so none
  needed updating.

## Excluded (binding, per triage)

- ⛔ Splitting the baseline per family
- ⛔ Dropping the DOWN direction
- ⛔ Computing the number instead of committing it
- ⛔ `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` untouched
- ⛔ `packages/cli/**` untouched (#14728, separate `domain:cli` defect)
